description: Dropdown context menu triggered by a custom element. Contains TmContextMenuItem children and closes on Escape key press. The menu is a top-layer TmOverlayPanel; it stays the anchored popover at every width unless the host opts into the shared mobile bottom sheet through MobilePresentation.

parameters.name: Trigger
parameters.description: The trigger element that opens the menu.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the menu presents on a narrow viewport. Default Popover: the anchored popover at every width. Auto opts into the shared content-height bottom sheet on a mobile viewport (the anchored popover otherwise). A forced value renders that presentation without measuring (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: SheetTitle
parameters.description: Title of the sheet header when the menu presents as a bottom sheet. When null (default), the localized TmContextMenu_SheetTitle default is used. The value also names the popover (aria-label) — the menu carries no other accessible name, so a role menu popover is not unnamed (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

examples.title: Context menu with actions
examples.code:
<TmContextMenu>
    <Trigger>
        <TmButton Variant="ButtonVariant.Ghost" Size="ButtonSize.Sm">...</TmButton>
    </Trigger>
    <ChildContent>
        <TmContextMenuItem Label="Edit" Icon="edit" OnClick="EditItem" />
        <TmContextMenuItem Label="Duplicate" Icon="copy" OnClick="DuplicateItem" />
        <TmContextMenuItem IsDivider="true" />
        <TmContextMenuItem Label="Delete" Icon="trash-2" IsDangerous="true" OnClick="DeleteItem" />
    </ChildContent>
</TmContextMenu>

examples.title: Opt-in mobile bottom sheet
examples.code:
<TmContextMenu MobilePresentation="PanelPresentation.Auto" SheetTitle="Row actions">
    <Trigger>
        <TmButton Variant="ButtonVariant.Ghost" Size="ButtonSize.Sm">Actions</TmButton>
    </Trigger>
    <ChildContent>
        <TmContextMenuItem Label="Edit" Icon="edit" OnClick="EditItem" />
    </ChildContent>
</TmContextMenu>
